night135.title: Starry Night Rock Formations
night135.description: A wide-angle night photograph shows a dark blue sky densely packed with countless white stars, stretching above a landscape of large, light-colored rock formations. These rugged, layered bluffs and a gravelly foreground are illuminated by a warm, yellowish light, highlighting their textures. A tall, slender rock pillar stands prominently in the center-left, adding to the majestic and serene mood of the scene.

night137.title: Night Gas Pump
night137.description: A dark, long-exposure photograph of a gas pump at night. The pump, labeled 'Self' at the top and 'PHILLIPS 66' on its base, stands prominently in the foreground. Streaks of red and white light from passing vehicles are visible in the midground, indicating a road, while a utility pole with power lines is silhouetted against the dark sky on the right. The overall mood is quiet and somewhat eerie.

night142.title: Sailboat at Twilight
night142.description: A tranquil, long-exposure photograph captures a sailboat moored in a calm body of water at twilight. The sky transitions from a reddish-orange on the left to a deep purple on the right, with faint star trails visible. The dark silhouettes of dense trees line the distant shore, their reflections mirroring perfectly in the still water. The sailboat, light yellow with a tall mast, is positioned on the right side of the frame, its reflection also visible below it. The overall mood is serene and peaceful.

night282.title: Tiger Shark at Night
night282.description: A long exposure photograph of the fishing boat 'Tiger Shark Sandy Marie' at night, with its tall mast reaching towards a dark, cloudy sky. The boat is weathered and rusty, sitting in calm, dark water. In the distance, a small island with trees is visible under a starry sky, and the clouds appear streaky from the long exposure.

night284.title: Monument Valley Night Sky
night284.description: A vertical night photograph captures a dark blue sky teeming with countless stars. Two brilliant celestial objects, likely planets, shine brightly in the upper half, with the larger one displaying a distinct starburst effect. Below, the dark silhouettes of several iconic buttes and mesas, characteristic of Monument Valley, rise from a landscape with patches of snow. A wet, reflective road curves across the foreground, leading towards a faint orange glow on the distant horizon.

night286.title: Moonlit Canyon Night
night286.description: A breathtaking night landscape captures a vast desert canyon under a star-filled, dark blue sky. A brilliant moon with a prominent starburst effect illuminates the upper right, casting light over the reddish-brown rocky foreground featuring sparse bushes, a gnarled dead tree, and a dark cliff on the right. The deep canyon below reveals intricate, shadowed geological formations, creating a serene and expansive wilderness scene.

night287.title: Rusting Car in Bushes
night287.description: A rusty, dark orange vintage car is almost completely overgrown by dense, bare, reddish-brown bushes and branches. The car's windshield is broken, and its chrome grille and headlight are visible through the tangled vegetation. The scene is set under a dark blue, star-filled night sky, giving it a mysterious and melancholic mood.

night288.title: Moonlit Tree Silhouette
night288.description: A low-angle view shows the dark, gnarled silhouette of a bare tree against a deep blue and purple night sky. A bright, glowing moon is visible through the intricate branches, creating an ethereal and mysterious atmosphere with scattered stars.

night289.title: Night Sky with Meteor
night289.description: A long exposure photograph captures a vibrant night sky filled with countless stars, with a bright, diagonal streak of light, likely a meteor or satellite, cutting across the upper left. Below, large, rugged rock formations, illuminated by a warm, subtle light, rise from the dark foreground, accompanied by sparse vegetation and tall grasses. The overall mood is serene and awe-inspiring.

night290.title: Old Tractor Under Stars
night290.description: An old, red International Harvester tractor is parked in a grassy field at night, illuminated by a warm, orange light. Above the silhouetted bare trees, a dark blue sky is filled with countless bright stars. The scene evokes a peaceful, rustic night.

night291.title: Night Light Painting Car
night291.description: A wide-angle, long-exposure photograph captures a rusty, two-tone blue and brown vintage car in a field at night. The moon glows brightly in the upper left, illuminating bare trees and a starry sky. Two blurred figures, one on the left with an orange light trail and one on the right with a white and blue light trail, appear to be 'light painting' the car. The car's interior is lit with a vibrant red glow, and its hood reflects a bright white light. Other dark, silhouetted vehicles are visible in the background among the trees.

night292.title: Night Train 201
night292.description: A majestic, dark-colored steam locomotive, number 201, is prominently displayed at night, viewed from a low angle. Its front features a large circular plate with '201' in orange, a bright headlight, and a cowcatcher, while a red locomotive, number 300, is partially visible behind it. The dark night sky above is filled with countless stars and wispy, streaked clouds, indicating a long exposure.

night293.title: Abandoned Plane Stars
night293.description: An old, weathered propeller plane, painted faded white and blue with a visible registration number 'N2555', sits abandoned in a field of tall green grass at night. The plane's fuselage and a distinctive blue and red logo on its tail are illuminated by artificial light, contrasting with the dark, star-filled sky above and a faint orange glow on the distant horizon.

night296.title: Milky Way Cross
night296.description: A long exposure photograph captures the Milky Way galaxy stretching across a dark night sky, filled with countless stars. In the foreground, silhouetted against the celestial backdrop, stands a rustic wooden cross atop a stone base, with dark tree lines visible below.

night298.title: Orion Over Red Rocks
night298.description: A wide-angle night photograph captures a vast, star-filled sky above a rugged desert landscape. The constellation Orion is clearly visible in the upper left, alongside a very bright star. A massive, reddish-brown rock formation, resembling a mesa or butte, dominates the right side of the frame, illuminated by a warm light, while the foreground shows rocky, reddish-orange terrain with sparse vegetation.

night299.title: Graveyard Under Stars
night299.description: A wide-angle night photograph captures a vast, star-filled sky above a dimly lit, eerie graveyard and an old, abandoned wooden building. In the foreground, a large stone cross and a weathered tombstone stand among bare trees, separated by a metal fence from the derelict building with a distinctive, broken roof. The countless stars and faint light create a mysterious and melancholic atmosphere.

night301.title: Haunted Rocking Chair
night301.description: A spooky, low-light image shows a white wooden rocking chair in a dark room. Above the chair, a glowing, fiery, demonic face with sharp teeth and red eyes hovers, emitting an orange smoke-like aura. A bright orange beam of light cuts across the floor, illuminating parts of the chair and the distressed wall behind it, creating a chilling and eerie atmosphere.

night302.title: Night Sky Church
night302.description: A stone church with a steeple and cross stands under a dark, star-filled night sky. To the right, a large, bare tree frames the scene, with a smaller house visible behind a white picket fence. The foreground features a wooden fence and dark, textured ground, illuminated by a soft, warm light that highlights the buildings and parts of the landscape.

night304.title: Moonlit Tower Reflection
night304.description: A long exposure night photograph shows a brick tower with illuminated windows reflected in still water under a star-filled, hazy sky. The moon, partially obscured by the tower, casts a bright glow, and trees on the right are lit with a warm, orange light, creating a mystical and serene atmosphere.

night305.title: The Grove Texas Night
night305.description: A nighttime long exposure photograph of a historic Texas town. Under a dark blue sky dotted with stars and soft clouds, several old buildings are illuminated: a brick general store and post office, a wooden saloon with a glowing interior, and a wooden blacksmith shop. A dirt road and a large prickly pear cactus occupy the foreground, evoking a quiet, nostalgic atmosphere.

night306.title: Stonehenge at Twilight
night306.description: A wide-angle night photograph captures a semi-circular arrangement of large, weathered stone structures, resembling Stonehenge. The monumental stones are illuminated from below with a warm, yellowish-green light, contrasting with the gradient twilight sky that shifts from purple to deep blue. Dark grass covers the foreground, and trees are visible in the distant background.

night308.title: Starry Night Cabin
night308.description: A long exposure photograph captures a starry night sky above a dilapidated wooden cabin nestled among dark trees. The cabin, with its weathered siding and three empty window frames, leans precariously to the right, surrounded by dry grass and sparse red foliage. The overall mood is eerie and mysterious.

night309.title: Milky Way Radio Telescope
night309.description: A large radio telescope dish stands prominently against a breathtaking night sky filled with countless stars and the luminous band of the Milky Way galaxy. The lower portion of the image is dark, suggesting a terrestrial landscape, while the upper two-thirds are dominated by the celestial display, with the telescope's intricate structure silhouetted against the cosmic backdrop.

night314.title: Starry Night Wagon
night314.description: An old, dilapidated wooden wagon with large, rust-rimmed wheels sits on dry grass under a vast, star-filled night sky. Dark silhouettes of mountains and bare trees form the backdrop, creating a serene yet mysterious and historical scene.

night315.title: Starry Night River
night315.description: A long exposure photograph captures a star-filled night sky above a flowing river. The river, illuminated by a soft glow, cascades over rocks and flows into the foreground, appearing smooth and ethereal due to the long exposure. Dark silhouettes of mountains frame the left side, while tall pine trees stand on the right, their dark forms contrasting with the bright stars. The overall mood is serene and majestic.

night317.title: Cave Milky Way
night317.description: A vertical shot captures a brilliant night sky, densely packed with white stars and the faint band of the Milky Way, as seen from within a dark cave or canyon. Rugged, dark rock formations frame the left side of the view, while tall, silhouetted evergreen trees frame the right, creating a natural archway to the cosmos. A subtle glow is visible near the bottom horizon, adding to the serene and awe-inspiring mood.

night320.title: Fisherman Statue Twilight
night320.description: A large, warmly lit statue of a bearded fisherman in a hat and coat stands in a boat, holding a fishing net. The scene is set at twilight, with a dramatic sky of dark blue and orange clouds over a calm body of water, reflecting distant industrial buildings and dark trees.

night321.title: Desert Night Sky
night321.description: A wide-angle shot of a dark desert landscape under a starry night sky. Several tall, red rock formations rise from the reddish-brown ground, which is sparsely covered with dark green bushes. The sky is a deep blue-grey, filled with countless tiny white stars, and a faint glow is visible near the horizon on the left.

night322.title: Fiery Pier Night
night322.description: A long-exposure photograph captures bright orange and yellow light trails from spinning steel wool on a dark wooden pier at night. The trails form chaotic, swirling patterns, concentrated in the center of a wooden structure, with some sparks arcing high into the dark sky and others scattering across the pier deck. In the background, across dark water, a city skyline glows with lights, including a prominent blue-lit building, under a dark night sky.

night323.title: Abandoned Gas Station Stars
night323.description: A wide-angle night photograph captures an abandoned, rustic gas station under a dark, star-filled sky. The building, constructed with textured, possibly stone or adobe walls, has a partially collapsed wooden porch roof, and is illuminated with a warm, golden light. In front stand several vintage, rusty red gas pumps, with a white animal skull hanging from the closest, surrounded by tall grass and dark trees on the horizon.

night326.title: Night Sky Church
night326.description: A wide-angle, low-light photograph captures a small, light-colored church with a prominent central tower, surrounded by dark, dense trees under a starry night sky. Wispy clouds are visible among the stars, and the foreground shows a grassy lawn and a dirt path, all dimly lit, suggesting a long exposure.

night327.title: Starry Night Bridge
night327.description: A wide-angle night photograph captures a serene landscape under a starry sky. On the left, a rugged cliff face is illuminated by a warm, golden light, revealing its textures and scattered trees. To the right, a dark, forested hill rises, while a bridge with white railings and a glowing road extends across the lower right, all beneath a vast expanse of countless white and blue stars.

night95.title: Milky Way Monolith
night95.description: A majestic night photograph captures a tall, dark, ancient-looking stone monolith standing under a brilliant starry sky. The Milky Way galaxy stretches diagonally across the upper right, glowing brightly with countless stars and cosmic dust. A faint orange glow from distant light pollution is visible on the horizon to the far left, while dark silhouettes of sparse vegetation frame the base of the stone.

night96.title: Aurora and City Glow
night96.description: A wide-angle night photograph captures a dark, star-filled sky over a landscape. On the left, an orange glow from light pollution illuminates the clouds above a dark treeline. To the right, vibrant green rays of the aurora borealis fan out across the sky, creating a striking contrast over a dimly lit, frosty field.

night310.title: Red Dragon Rock Night
night310.description: A dramatic low-angle shot of a rugged, reddish-orange rock formation at night, with a prominent section on the left intensely illuminated in bright red. This red-lit section strikingly resembles the head and neck of a roaring dragon, featuring an open mouth and an eye-like hole. The formation stands against a deep blue night sky dotted with numerous white stars.
